steps.title: Your first run
steps.body: You are Teresā Albukerkē, and you lost the election. You have 72 hours to reach a jet and get out. This demo walks you across the border, and you play the airfield on your own.
steps.goal: Know the goal and the deadline

steps.title: Reading the scene
steps.body: The gold dot over your head is you, and the box in the corner names the place Sosā is searching. While he searches where you are, your police attention climbs, and at 10 the police stop you. Each stop within 12 hours of the last is worse, and the third step is house arrest.
steps.goal: Read police attention and where Sosā is searching

steps.title: A round
steps.body: Each turn, answer anyone who calls, make up to one call, then make one move. When the move is done, you see what happened during the hours it took, including what Sosā did.
steps.goal: Know what a turn is

steps.title: Your brother is on the phone
steps.body: Duartē has found a jet, but the crew will not book without a destination. Tap **Confirm Lāyūna**. The demo picked it for you.
steps.goal: Answer a message

steps.title: Call about the jet
steps.body: Tap **Duartē Albukerkē about the jet**, then **Call**. The call takes an hour, and his answer comes six hours after that.
steps.goal: Start an arrangement by phone

steps.title: A promise is not a plane
steps.body: The route shows when Duartē owes you an answer, but he still has to come through. If he fails, you call again.
steps.goal: Tell a promise from a delivered arrangement

steps.title: Get out of the house
steps.body: Pick **Decoy convoy**, read the time and the roll it needs, then tap **Try it**. You can do this because Nando gave you the cars.
steps.goal: Read a move before committing

steps.title: Cards and the die
steps.body: Cards lower the number you need, and using one does not use it up. You lose a card when its owner turns on you or you give it up, and a card that gets you onto the freight is gone as soon as you move to another stop. You are in Santa Laura now, and Sosā is still searching the residence.
steps.goal: See how cards change the roll

steps.title: Sosā moves too
steps.body: Every three hours, Sosā does something. This time he sent the travel ban to every post. If the police stop you now, they take you straight to the station. Each border crossing also needs a roll one higher, unless you hold a card that delays the report.
steps.goal: See the inquiry act on a schedule

steps.title: Ask for the visa
steps.body: Tap **Bīr Amādū Salek about your visa**, then **Call**. He can get Atlanta to let you in. Later he asks for the family accounts. Agreeing makes the visa more likely, and if you refuse he still asks at the usual odds.
steps.goal: Ask a sponsor for your visa

steps.title: Pay someone who takes money
steps.body: Nando's cousin drives for cash. Pick **Hire a plain car and driver**, then tap **Try it**.
steps.goal: Use an ally who takes money

steps.title: Things moved while you drove
steps.body: Duartē booked the crew, and the ministry told the papers you had left the country. Sosā is searching Portô Venla, which is not where you are.
steps.goal: See arrangements progress while you travel

steps.title: Nonā Rosa needs something first
steps.body: Her cooperative's truck was impounded this morning. Pick **Help Nonā Rosa free the truck**, then tap **Try it**. It takes three hours. She gives you the truck either way, and if it works, her truck also carries you on to Salta.
steps.goal: Earn help by helping

steps.title: People give you cards
steps.body: You are in Salta now. Nonā Rosa's truck helps your rolls here without you doing anything. Helping her also made her trust you more, and people who trust you are less likely to talk when Sosā questions them.
steps.goal: Know that trust lowers the risk of betrayal

steps.title: Who meets you on the other side
steps.body: Tap **Duartē Albukerkē about your welcome in Esmeralda**, then **Call**. He can reach Rosario Vélez in Esmeralda. Each call that comes through moves your welcome one step, and at the third step her officials wait for you at one border post.
steps.goal: Arrange reception across the line

steps.title: Onto the freight
steps.body: Pick **Pay Holt for a crate**, then tap **Try it**. Your truck card helps the roll. Never pay the yardmaster. He takes the money and tells the yard who you are, and your police attention rises by two.
steps.goal: Get a card for one place

steps.title: Onto the train
steps.body: Holt's crate works only in the Salta yard, and only at night. Tap **Board the midnight freight**, then **Try it**. With the card, this move needs no roll and will succeed, and the card is gone once the train leaves Salta.
steps.goal: Spend a card where it counts

steps.title: The line
steps.body: Three posts cross into Esmeralda, and Valdória has paid one of them. You do not know which. If Duartē's calls get Vélez's officials to the line, they meet you at one of the other two, and crossing there needs no roll.
steps.goal: Know what the three posts mean

steps.title: The rail post
steps.body: Pick **Cross at the Paso Huhūi post**, then tap **Try it**. Your second passport lets you try it, and the party machine lowers the number you need. The travel ban and your well-known face each raise it by one.
steps.goal: Read how the ban changes a roll

steps.title: Susana
steps.body: You made it across. Esmeralda lets you fly out of Susana and nothing more, and your party cards do not count in this country. Get the jet ready and the visa issued, then board. Tap **Finish** to play the rest on your own.
steps.goal: Play the airfield alone

steps.title: Your first run as Sofīā
steps.goal: Know the goal and what you cannot see
steps.body: You are Sofīā Leōnī, aide to the incoming government. Teresā Albukerkē has until Tuesday at 2 p.m. to fly out, and your job is to stop her. You never see where she is, only reports, and reports come late.

steps.title: Reading the scene
steps.goal: Tell your search from her position
steps.body: The scene shows where your people are looking, and the box at the top says how old your last report is. She could be anywhere else on the route.

steps.title: A round
steps.goal: Know what a turn is
steps.body: Each turn, answer the minister, send up to one request, then give one order. When the order is done, you see what came back during the hours it took.

steps.title: The minister wants a town
steps.goal: Answer a message without guessing
steps.body: If you name the wrong town, the minister announces it on the news, every desk in the province drives there, and it counts against you at the end. Pick **Ask for six hours**.

steps.title: Ask Esmeralda now
steps.goal: Start a slow request before you need it
steps.body: Your orders stop at the border, but Esmeralda can hold her for you. The embassy takes 10 hours to answer, so pick **Ask Esmeralda to hold her**, then **Send**.

steps.title: Put the ban on paper
steps.goal: Read an order before sending it
steps.body: Pick **Circulate the travel ban**, read the roll and the hours, then tap **Send the order**.

steps.title: A report is not proof
steps.goal: Judge a report by what it proves
steps.body: She moved while your order ran. Tap **Read the new reports**. Each report says what it proves and what it does not. A car leaving a house does not prove she is in the car.

steps.title: Things happen at the ministry
steps.goal: Weigh a choice by what it costs and brings
steps.body: Every five hours something lands on your desk, and each choice lists what it costs and what it can bring. A real lead adds a report from where she really is, and a false lead adds one from a stop where she is not. When the card opens, pick **Check the one that gave plates**.

steps.title: A sent ban is not a closed border
steps.goal: Confirm a request reached the people who act on it
steps.body: The ban went out, but nobody at the post has read it. Pick **Confirm the ban at the post**, then **Send**.

steps.title: Act on the lead
steps.goal: Move the search to the newest report
steps.body: The plates were real. Follow the report to point your search at Santa Laura. Following a report puts nobody on the ground, so then tap **Search Santa Laura**.

steps.title: How she gets caught
steps.goal: Know how searches turn into holds
steps.body: When an order puts Sosā's people on her stop, her police attention climbs, and at 10 the police stop her. Each stop within 12 hours of the last is worse, and the third step is house arrest, which is your win. When your people are on her stop, she takes riskier moves to get away.

steps.title: The rest is yours
steps.goal: Play on without the guide
steps.body: The dice and the news are real from here. The debrief at the end shows where she really was. Tap **Finish**.
